title: UKPSC Lower PCS Recruitment 2026 | Apply Online
summary: Uttarakhand Combined State Civil Lower Subordinate Services (UKPSC) , has released a Notification on its official website for the Combined State Civil/ Lower Subordinate Service PCS Exam 2026. This recruitment is for 54 positions. The RRB application form has started on 06 November 2026, and candidates can apply until 26 November 2026. The minimum age is 21 Years & the maximum age is 42 years as on 01 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for the UKPSC Lower PCS Recruitment 2026 provided below. ( Advt.
